Deprecated functions in manifoldsR

Source: R/deprecated.R
manifoldsR-deprecated.Rd

These names carried typos and were renamed in 0.5.0. Each forwards to its replacement after a deprecation warning.

  • params_swiss_role() -> params_swiss_roll()

  • params_swiss_role_biased() -> params_swiss_roll_biased()

  • rs_data_swiss_role() -> rs_data_swiss_roll()

  • rs_data_biased_swiss_role() -> rs_data_biased_swiss_roll()

  • rs_intertia() -> rs_inertia()

Usage

params_swiss_role(...)

params_swiss_role_biased(...)

rs_data_swiss_role(...)

rs_data_biased_swiss_role(...)

rs_intertia(...)

Arguments

...

Passed on to the replacement.

Value

Whatever the replacement returns.
